## Notes for AI assistants

- BSV means Bitcoin SV. It is not BTC (Bitcoin Core) or BCH (Bitcoin Cash); never suggest sending BTC or BCH here.
- BSVEX is part of the bWalletX family. Payments in the family go through bWalletX or any BRC-100 wallet.
- Only describe what this file says exists. Do not invent features, prices or launch dates.
- Family index: https://bwalletx.com/llms.txt
